manifest.title: First-arrival travel-time tomography over one chamber

crosshole.name: crosshole
crosshole.description: Four boreholes 12 m from the chamber; sparker every 3 m, hydrophones every 1 m, 5-30 m deep

surface.name: surface
surface.description: A 5 x 5 hammer grid (8 m) over a 9 x 9 geophone grid (4 m), vertical impacts

finding: Crosshole rays through the chamber recover it as a slow patch of -11% (air would be -90%): first arrivals bend around a void, so travel-time tomography sees its shadow, not its emptiness. From the surface, with the direct P picked on 16 stacked blows, the same method recovers +0.0%: in uniform rock no first-arrival ray reaches 12 m.
